capabilities: Generate a cloze reading view from the current note with AI
Adjust cloze density (0-100%) with a real-time slider
Reveal and hide answers in place by clicking blanks
Review blanks as cards with Again/Hard/Good/Easy SM-2 scheduling
Write Good/Easy terms back to the note as cloze flashcards
extras: Includes a demo note (demo/demo-note.md) for trying the features; warns that auto-cloze on long uncached notes consumes many AI tokens. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn an existing note into a cloze-deletion reading exercise or to test recall on it without manually authoring flashcards.

relations.evidence: compatible with the Spaced Repetition plugin

summary: AI-powered reading view that blanks out key points in any note and reviews them with SM-2 spaced repetition.
